enrollment.useSourceDefaults: Use provided defaults: 2 vCPU / 4096 MiB / 1024 GiB
enrollment.convergeTitle: Apply policy to existing personal projects
enrollment.convergeHelp: Save the desired policy first. Browse every page and preview one project at a time. Applying changes native quota limits only, never creates a volume or changes existing resources. Owner, provenance, policy, usage and reservations are rechecked. Old frozen provisioning intents are unchanged.
enrollment.convergeBlocked: Application blocked: usage exceeds the proposed quota. No resources will be deleted.
enrollment.convergeConfirm: I reviewed the limits and current usage for this exact project.
enrollment.convergeUnknown: Quota outcome is partial or unknown. Do not replay; inspect and settle the operation before another change. Operation:
enrollment.convergeFailed: Could not verify or apply this project. Reload a preview; uncertain native operations require explicit administrator settlement.
enrollment.notificationFailed: Approval remains recorded, but the email notification failed. Reload requests to inspect the approved state. Do not repeat approval to resend mail.
enrollment.title: Enrollment policy
enrollment.summary: Control new-account admission and quotas for future personal projects.
enrollment.futureOnly: Saving changes defaults for future personal projects only. Review and apply existing projects separately below; accounts and resources are not changed automatically.
enrollment.emailHelp: This toggle controls new public email registrations only, not existing sign-in or otherwise permitted external providers. Email verification also requires SMTP.
enrollment.approvalHelp: Applies to new email, OIDC and GitHub identities. Changing the mode does not approve pending requests or revive rejected requests.
enrollment.quotaHelp: -1 means unlimited; 0 means zero allocation. Blank explicitly omits that quota and uses the native default, not zero or unlimited. Only fields exposed by the API are editable.
enrollment.invalidQuota: Enter whole numbers of zero or greater, or -1 for unlimited. Leave a field blank to use the native default.
enrollment.smtpReady: SMTP is configured. This is configuration readiness, not proof of email delivery.
enrollment.smtpMissing: SMTP is not configured. Public email verification cannot complete, even when email registration is enabled.
enrollment.mailUnconfirmed: The review API provides no mail delivery result. Approval alone does not confirm that an email was sent or delivered.
enrollment.loadFailed: Could not load enrollment policy. Reload explicitly to try again.
enrollment.saved: Default policy saved for new personal projects. Existing projects require separate review and application.
enrollment.conflict: The policy revision changed. Reload and discard this draft before making a new edit. Your save was not replayed.
enrollment.saveFailed: The save outcome is not confirmed. Reload the current policy before editing again; the mutation will not be replayed.
enrollment.authorityRequired: Verified system-administrator authority is required to view this policy.
enrollment.reviewHelp: Approve or reject pending requests explicitly. Approval records permission only; it does not create a native user, domain or project. The applicant must complete enrollment; external-provider applicants must start a fresh sign-in.
enrollment.queueFailed: Could not load signup requests. No empty queue has been confirmed. Reload explicitly to try again.
enrollment.empty: No requests on this page for the selected status.
enrollment.loadedCount: Requests on this page: {count}. This is not the total queue size.
enrollment.decisionRecorded: Review recorded for {email}: {status}. No native account was created by this decision.
enrollment.decisionFailed: The review outcome is not confirmed. Reload requests before taking another action. The decision will not be replayed.
